name: Superman Push-Up
steps: Assume a straight high-plank position on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and your entire core braced.
Lower your chest smoothly toward the floor with your elbows angled roughly 45 degrees from your ribs.
Explode powerfully upward through both your hands and feet so your entire body leaves the floor, extending your arms swiftly forward overhead in midair.
Draw your hands rapidly back under your shoulders and land softly on your palms and toes with bent elbows to absorb the impact cleanly.
tips: Master clap push-ups first and perform this move on a forgiving surface to cushion your wrists.
Keep your abs and glutes braced tightly during flight so your lower back does not snap into an arch.
